<!--
  Skirmish II has one design law: the mechanics are finished, like chess.
  Nobody — maintainer or contributor — changes a rule, a balance value,
  or a mechanic on their own. The ONLY direction a behavior may move is
  toward documented Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition behavior,
  backed by public evidence.

  That is why this template requires a citation. A fidelity report with
  solid public evidence is the fastest kind of issue to be accepted and
  fixed. A report without evidence cannot change any behavior — it will
  be parked as a question until evidence arrives.
-->
